Meta Muse Gadget SDK protocol subset

Source: https://github.com/facebookincubator/muse-gadget-sdk
Revision: 812c46f9fe42b69d916613a9dc702cbac5ff7b54
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in this directory).

Only pairing, BLE framing/setup, device API and encrypted transport modules are included. No executor, shell/file commands, installer, daemon or local control socket is included. Android integration and restricted workspace commands live in puck_muse.py.

The SDK's Jollybot avatar is excluded from its Apache license and is not
redistributed by this build. The launcher companion is original Puck Canvas
artwork, not a downloaded personal/account avatar.
